newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Trade quiet ahead of holiday.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Trade quiet ahead of holiday.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices were mixed on Wednesday in quiet dealings ahead of the Good Friday and Easter holidays this weekend, cash sources said.
"It's a holiday market, pretty thin," one dealer said.
Prices were mixed with strength seen in Minneapolis and Kansas City as mill run times were decreased due to the holiday weekend.

In Buffalo, one dealer said nearby bids and offers had been pulled because run times were too low to guarantee spot supplies. He cited poor flour demand and in one case routine maintenance as contributing factors for short run times.
"One just has lack of flour business and another has a routine fumigation scheduled," the Buffalo dealer said. "They'll get back into business next week."
But he said the short-term tight supply situation had some dealers concerned they could not fill spot orders.
"We have feed sold that hasn't been milled," the dealer said. "That's causing a bit of alarm."
He said buyers will likely search other markets for supplies and some were already looking to secure transportation to bring in the supplies.
